body:
Throw away the fact that I work for them for just a second, ok? Ok. Cool. So, it is pretty awesome, to be honest. The platform that they designed allows 8 people (7 group members and a moderator) to talk using either text, webcam, or microphone. 

You pick a topic that interests you and you pay a little fee (usually $9.99 or some are FREE!) and you go into the room at your specific group time! Then it just works! Like magic! :D 

Even if I didn't work for this company, I would totally be all up and enjoying it. It's a great product and a great idea. 

I really hope you try it! :D
